paper_title: Spectrum of global string networks and the axion dark matter mass
suggested_experiment_name: Axion DM mass compilation (adapted from AxionLimits/Ciaran O'Hare), FIG.1
coupling_convention: C_agamma, dimensionless axion-photon coupling (model coupling, NOT g_agamma in GeV^-1)
notes: This is a theoretical/numerical cosmology paper predicting the post-inflationary QCD axion dark matter mass from global string network simulations. The main result is a predicted mass RANGE m_a ~= 95-450 ueV, not an exclusion limit or sensitivity projection with a coupling on the y-axis. Figure 1 shows previous mass estimates confronted with existing constraints on C_agamma (adapted from another reference), but the paper itself does not produce a new coupling-vs-mass exclusion curve. No extractable (mass, coupling) data points for a new limit exist; the result is a mass prediction, not an f_a-m_a exclusion bound.
